title: Dwarf Fortress Creator Explains its Complexity & Origins | Noclip Interview
summary: A /noclip interview with Tarn Adams of Bay 12 Games about Dwarf Fortress: where the ASCII simulation came from, how it works, and the plans for its Steam release. It includes his telling of the famous bug in which cats were poisoned by alcohol.
why: HN points to it whenever Dwarf Fortress comes up, mainly for the alcohol-poisoned cats bug story and a developer's view of the game's depth.

quote.text: This interview with Tarn Adams (one of the creators of dwarf fortress) is amazing
